script_note: The bundled script reads public HTML, RSS, hot-guide, and selected thread pages.
source_requirement: A title, RSS description, or hot-guide row is discovery evidence; implementation or procedure claims require reading the public thread page.
agent_rule: One forum Agent uses RSS or listing pages for discovery, then reads selected public thread pages sequentially.
access_scope: Public HTML, public RSS, and public thread pages only; no login, internal search, posting, redirects, member pages, or attachment downloads.
notes: The bundled child Skill uses local filtering because the site's robots.txt disallows search.php. Search results are bounded by the requested forum pages and RSS coverage.
